test_title: PYST 23: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was a key reform introduced by the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025?

options.text: Inclusion of Muslim women on Waqf Boards

solution:
The correct answer is __**Inclusion of Muslim women on Waqf Boards**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025 introduced reforms aimed at greater inclusivity by mandating the **representation of Muslim women on Waqf Boards**.
 
• This amendment sought to ensure **gender equality** and promote the participation of women in the management of Waqf properties.
 
• It emphasized the need for a minimum quota for **women members** on Waqf Boards, fostering transparency and balanced decision-making.
 
• The reform aligns with the government's broader objective of **empowering women** in all aspects of governance and administration.
 
• Under this Act, states were tasked with ensuring **implementation of the inclusion mandate** to bring systemic change within Waqf governance structures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Waqf:** Waqf refers to a charitable endowment under Islamic law, typically involving property or assets donated for religious or philanthropic purposes.
 
• **Waqf Board:** These are statutory bodies responsible for managing and administering Waqf properties and ensuring their proper utilization.
 
• **Gender Inclusivity:** The inclusion of women in governance structures helps in achieving equitable representation and supports broader social reforms.
 
• **Previous Amendments:** Earlier amendments to Waqf laws have focused on transparency, digitization of records, and anti-corruption measures to safeguard assets.
 
• **Legal Framework:** Waqf legislation in India is governed by the Waqf Act, 1995, and its subsequent amendments, which aim to modernize and streamline the management of Waqf properties.
